mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.grd_cd,p.cust_ptnr_id FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id

SELECT n.need_id,n.oppt_id,o.oppt_nm,n.job_cd,n.grd_cd,n.bgn_ym, to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM') + (n.mnth_qty-1)*interval '1 month','YYYY-MM') AS end_ym, n.psn_cnt-(SELECT count(*)::integer FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t WHERE t.need_id=n.need_id AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE') AS remaining_slots, o.cust_ptnr_id,o.win_prblt_rt FROM bsn.oppt_need n JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id WHERE o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' AND n.use_yn='Y' AND n.mnth_qty>0 AND n.psn_cnt>(SELECT count(*) FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t WHERE t.need_id=n.need_id AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE') ORDER BY n.need_id
SELECT dtl_cd FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id='GRADE' ORDER BY sort_seq,dtl_cd
SELECT main_job_cd FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{devId} UNION SELECT job_cd FROM mst.dev_sub_job WHERE dev_id=#{devId}

SELECT t.tmpr_asgn_id AS id,t.need_id,t.dev_id,t.bgn_ym, coalesce(t.end_ym,to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM')+(n.mnth_qty-1)*interval '1 month','YYYY-MM')) AS end_ym, t.mm_qty AS mth_mm_qty,t.tmpr_asgn_src_cd,t.mtch_scr,t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd AS status,t.asgn_id FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.need_id=t.need_id WHERE t.dev_id=#{devId} AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.bgn_ym,t.tmpr_asgn_id
